profile: American English; each engine's default local rules. No AI, n-gram data, engine suggestions or engine results supplied to editor agents.
input_format: Same plain-text strings for both engines. Fenced code masked with spaces while preserving code-point offsets; all compared strings and hashes are stored. Native Markdown behavior is not ranked by this core comparison.
custom_policy: Additional post-filter view removes only spelling-category findings whose exact source text matches a declared accepted term. Raw results remain available. This is not a claim of exhaustive domain vocabulary.
scoring: Expected spans and issue/control labels were frozen before executing either engine on this corpus. Candidate overlap is not proof that a message correctly diagnoses the issue; inspect the actual rule and proposed fix. Stylistic suggestions on controls are classified separately from clear false positives.
limits: Small authored probes, not general product accuracy rates.
15 known regression inputs and 12 new inputs.
Different engine defaults are retained and recorded; this compares these configurations, not equivalent rule implementations.
LanguageTool 6.6 is an explicitly pinned released build, not a claim that it is the latest commercial product.
Three fresh-process runs will assess normalized result stability.
